content.intro: Experiment with the interactive Turnitin Similarity Report Simulator below to see how overall percentages, single-source thresholds, and exclusion filters (references, small matches, quotes) change your official compliance status under HEC Pakistan rules.
key: The HEC similarity ceiling is 19% overall, but no single primary source may exceed 5%.
If a paper has 12% overall similarity but 7% comes from a single student paper in Lahore, it FAILS HEC compliance.
Bibliography and properly punctuated direct quotations with page numbers must be excluded by the institutional Turnitin administrator.
